tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind every page and the sidebar's ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, chart panels, tables, menus, the chat panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: the filter bar, code and query-plan blocks, table header row, input fields at rest.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative only, never the sole edge of a control).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (meets 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card subtitles, axis labels, table meta, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, timestamps, footnotes, on any surface (4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: lens
tokens.usage: The brand colour, matched to the logo blue (#0064FC) and darkened a step so it passes 4.5:1 as text. Primary buttons, active nav item, focus ring, links, the selected segment. As text it reads on every surface and on lens-soft.

tokens.name: lens-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind lens text: active nav row, selected filter chips, the user's chat bubble.

tokens.name: on-lens
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lens fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links: an alias of lens.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Status fill: on target, guardrail passed, query succeeded. Always with an icon + label.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status fill: needs a look (stale data, slow query). Always with an icon + label.

tokens.name: serious
tokens.usage: Status fill: degraded (auto-repaired query, fallback model used). Always with an icon + label.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Status fill: failed or blocked (guardrail block, anomaly flagged). Always with an icon + label.

tokens.name: good-ink
tokens.usage: Text of good pills and positive KPI deltas, on good-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of good pills.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text of warning pills, on warning-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning pills and warning alerts.

tokens.name: serious-ink
tokens.usage: Text of serious pills, on serious-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: serious-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of serious pills and serious alerts.

tokens.name: critical-ink
tokens.usage: Text of critical pills and negative KPI deltas, on critical-soft and surface-raised.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of critical pills and blocked-query alerts.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 1 (orange). Assign in fixed order 1→8, by entity, never by rank. Default colour for single-series charts. Scatter plots and maps use slots 1–2 only.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 2 (aqua). Assign in fixed order 1→8, by entity, never by rank. Scatter plots and maps use slots 1–2 only. Below 3:1 on light surfaces: pair with direct labels or the table view.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 3 (yellow). Assign in fixed order 1→8, by entity, never by rank. Below 3:1 on light surfaces: pair with direct labels or the table view.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 4 (violet). Assign in fixed order 1→8, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 5 (green). Assign in fixed order 1→8, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 6 (magenta). Assign in fixed order 1→8, by entity, never by rank. Below 3:1 on light surfaces: pair with direct labels or the table view.

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 7 (blue). Assign in fixed order 1→8, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Chart categorical slot 8 (red). Assign in fixed order 1→8, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential (magnitude) ramp, one hue, low→high: heatmaps such as the RFM grid and region choropleth. Step 1 recedes toward the surface by design.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential (magnitude) ramp, one hue, low→high: heatmaps such as the RFM grid and region choropleth.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential (magnitude) ramp, one hue, low→high: heatmaps such as the RFM grid and region choropleth.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential (magnitude) ramp, one hue, low→high: heatmaps such as the RFM grid and region choropleth.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential (magnitude) ramp, one hue, low→high: heatmaps such as the RFM grid and region choropleth.

tokens.name: div-neg
tokens.usage: Diverging negative pole: loss, below-plan margin.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging neutral midpoint (zero, on plan). Grey, never a hue.

tokens.name: div-pos
tokens.usage: Diverging positive pole: profit, above-plan margin.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines (recessive, 1px).

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart baseline and axis line.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Schibsted Grotesk, from Google Fonts. Page titles and the wordmark only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the page title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles inside a long page, modal titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans, from Google Fonts. Everything a person reads or operates.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Revenue grew fastest in the Electronics category during Q4.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card subtitles, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, legend items, pill text, axis tick labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the sidebar and KPI labels. Set in uppercase.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Numbers always use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: The headline number on a KPI card.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Right-aligned numeric table cells and tooltip values.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Query plans, SQL, column names, token counts.

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense enough for a BI screen, never tighter than space-2 inside a control.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, legend item gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows, table cell padding inline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in the dashboard grid, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, page top on wide screens.

radius.note: Tight and precise, like a viewfinder frame. Only pills and dots are round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bar ends, checkbox, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, chart panels, alerts, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the AI assistant drawer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, filter chips, legend dots.

shadow.note: Borders do the work; shadows only lift things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest (with a line border).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, chart tooltips, the assistant drawer.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px gap, then 2px of solid lens.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed left navigation at 1024px and wider; collapses to a top bar below.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Page header with title, dataset version and the assistant toggle.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented control (sm buttons: 28px).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the dashboard grid.
